summary.intent: Fix failing CI checks on PR #346 for cipher-box, specifically a branch coverage threshold failure and unresolved PR review threads.
summary.outcome: Identified three untested Phase 21 files causing branch coverage to drop to 72.68% (below 80% threshold) and delegated test writing to an agent; simultaneously triaged 8 PR review threads and committed fixes for valid ones, deferring the push until tests were ready to combine both commits.

repo: TypeORM defaults to TIMESTAMP (not TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) — migrations must use TIMESTAMP to avoid drift against the schema baseline.
Phase 21 introduced migration.controller.ts, migration.processor.ts, and tee.controller.ts with 0% branch coverage, which broke the global 80% branch threshold.
@nestjs/throttler v6 uses TTL in milliseconds — Copilot review suggestions about TTL units were incorrect and should be ignored.
The startMigration method was optimized to use .count() instead of .find(), requiring mock updates in migration.service.spec.ts.

workflow: Parallelizing agent-based test writing with manual PR review triage is an effective strategy for multi-concern CI failures.
Combining related commits before pushing (tests + review fixes) reduces CI noise and keeps PR history cleaner.
When Copilot suggests fixes, verify against the actual library version before applying — v6 breaking changes can make AI suggestions incorrect.
